## Constraints

### Must

- Preserve the existing Next.js App Router architecture and multilingual routing.
- Use only verified product models, images, specifications, certifications and commercial terms already present in the project.
- Keep public product pricing private and route wholesale buyers toward quotation and inquiry actions.
- Maintain a unified premium technology-and-coffee visual system across public pages and responsive breakpoints.
- Treat accessibility, mobile usability, performance, SEO and GEO discoverability as release requirements.

### Avoid

- Do not invent certifications, factory capacity, customer reviews, MOQ, lead time, warranty or product specifications.
- Do not replace model-specific photography or mix images and specifications between DQ models.
- Do not introduce generic ecommerce templates, excessive text, low-contrast controls or decorative effects that obscure content.
- Do not add heavy 3D or animation dependencies without a lightweight fallback and measured performance review.
